reference_build.product: Age of Empires, the Rise of Rome

capture_contract.difficulty_policy: repeat at every supported campaign difficulty
capture_contract.seed_policy: record every seed and repeat each boundary case at least five times
capture_contract.visibility: all resources, build sites and observed workers remain visible and unchanged except for the isolated variable
capture_contract.isolation: change only population size, one percentage/cap, or one worker lifecycle event per case
capture_contract.comparison_rule: record actual role transitions and orders; do not infer rounding or redistribution from final resource totals

scenes.purpose: Recover the population base, rounding method and treatment of percentages whose sum differs from 100.
Determine whether capped surplus is redistributed and in which deterministic role order caps are applied.
Recover when builders/explorers/gatherers may be retasked after commands, death, production, foundation completion and exploration changes.

completion_rules: Every scene has immutable original artifacts, executable and DAT hashes, and all required metrics.
Population boundary cases 1 through 12 and at least two larger populations are captured.
The accepted allocation policy predicts withheld percentage sums, cap combinations and event transitions.
The runtime planner has one serialized workforce owner and never issues two commands to one worker in a decision tick.
Explorer assignment groups and build/foundation reservations share the same authoritative roster.
The gate status changes to measured only after automated validation and campaign regression tests pass.
